_comment: naubd needs almost no configuration. The V2 panel picks its own source from the app switcher and the host remembers it in %LOCALAPPDATA%\naub\pins.json, so there is no channel->process mapping to write down any more (V1's 'channels' block is ignored if you leave one here). Copy this to config.json only if you need to override a default; without any config.json at all the daemon runs on exactly these values.
_port: 'auto' finds the board's CDC *data* port by USB VID/PID. Set a name like 'COM10' to pin it.
_rate: Meter frames per second, an upper bound rather than a promise. The device smooths these with its own ballistics, so raising it buys very little.
